sonnet.problem: The question says "hear from heaven, His dwelling place," which is the right answer to card 11 ("From heaven where He dwells"). That reuses an answer already shown on an earlier card and re-asks verse 21.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The joke about not admitting a lopsided cookie has no shared action with the temple being unable to contain God. A stranger would say "huh?"
sonnet.rule: The everyday comparison must have the same action.

sonnet.problem: Story card 1 already says the man comes "before the altar in this temple," which gives away the answer "In this temple" before the choice card asks for it.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
